title: CaptnJason's Server Pack
description: This server pack provides an optimized server base for any CaptnJason Development Studios operated servers.
body:
This pack is based on [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized), "A simple Minecraft modpack focusing on performance and graphics enhancements."

CaptnJason's Server Pack is purpose built for vanilla and modded gameplay, with a focus on preserving vanilla behavior for technical players where possible. It also includes tools aimed at helping server operators and staff manage relatively small servers.

SNAPSHOT packs may include mods used on CaptnJason servers, instead of being a vanilla base. For testing purposes.
